title: FacEDiT: Talking Head Video Editing via Facial Motion Infilling
abstract: arXiv:2512.14056v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Editing a local segment of a talking head video without reshooting the scene remains challenging and underexplored. Local edits, such as insertion, deletion, or substitution, require synthesizing a replacement segment while leaving the rest of the video unchanged. This involves variable-duration local rewriting while preserving identity, unedited regions, and boundary continuity, which standard speech-driven generation and lip synchronization methods do not directly address. Moreover, direct supervision is impractical, as it would require paired videos of the same person and scene that differ only in a local spoken segment. We instead formulate talking head video editing as facial motion infilling, a self-supervised pretext task that recovers masked facial motion from speech and surrounding motion context using ordinary video--speech pairs. Our key insight is that local video editing can be simulated during training by masking

translated_title: FacEDiT：通过面部动作填充实现说话头部视频编辑
translated_abstract: 对说话头部视频的局部片段进行编辑而无需重新拍摄场景，仍然是一个具有挑战性且研究不足的问题。局部编辑，如插入、删除或替换，需要在保持视频其余部分不变的情况下合成替换片段。这涉及可变时长的局部重写，同时需要保持身份一致性、未编辑区域和边界连续性，而标准的语音驱动生成和唇形同步方法并不能直接解决这些问题。此外，直接监督是不切实际的，因为它需要同一人物和场景的成对视频，且这些视频仅在局部语音片段上有所不同。为此，我们将说话头部视频编辑重新表述为面部动作填充，这是一种自监督预训练任务，利用普通的视频-语音对，从语音和周围动作上下文中恢复被遮蔽的面部动作。我们的关键洞察是，局部视频编辑可以在训练过程中通过遮蔽来模拟。
tldr: 该论文提出FacEDiT，将说话头部视频的局部编辑建模为面部动作填充这一自监督任务，无需成对的直接监督数据，即可利用普通视频-语音对实现保持身份一致性和边界连续性的局部视频编辑。
en_tdlr: FacEDiT formulates talking head video editing as a self-supervised facial motion infilling task, enabling local edits with identity and boundary preservation without requiring paired supervision, using only ordinary video-speech data.
